meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 agent 容器里安装 Vercel CLI，并通过 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭证，让 agent 能直接部署 Web 应用、查看部署记录、检查登录状态。它需要你先提供一枚 Vercel 个人访问令牌。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时会触发。前提是 OneCLI 已就绪，否则需先运行 /init-onecli。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我当前的 Vercel 部署
检查一下我的 Vercel 登录状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude installs the Vercel CLI inside agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials, so agents can deploy web apps, list deployments, and check auth. You must supply a Vercel personal access token first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. Requires OneCLI to be working; otherwise run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
